summary.text: 家 is formed from 宀 above a lower element whose identity and role are disputed. 宀 contributes a roof or dwelling idea. The graph is used early for dwelling and household-related meanings; today it commonly means house, home, or family.

formation.text: The traditional analysis treats the lower form as an abbreviated 豭 serving as a sound element, alongside 宀 for dwelling. Other analyses interpret it as a pig beneath a roof and propose “pig enclosure” as an original meaning. The phonetic analysis is plausible if 豭 is the relevant element, but the earliest lower sign’s identity and the graph’s original construction remain disputed.

components.text: 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling idea in the graph. It appears as a full component; no separate earlier form is proposed.
The visible lower form is 豕. The traditional account treats it as an abbreviated 豭 used for sound; other accounts interpret it as a pig in the scene. Its earliest identity remains disputed.

sound_limitation.text: The readings make a sound relationship plausible if 豭 is the relevant element; they do not identify the earliest lower sign or provide a reading for the proposed sign 𢑓.

sound.text: The current Mandarin readings of 家 and proposed sound element 豭 match; this comparison does not establish that the visible 豕 represents 豭.
The reconstructed Middle Chinese forms match, supporting phonetic compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element.
The reconstructed Old Chinese forms match, supporting phonetic compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element.

history.text: The traditional written analysis identifies the lower form as an abbreviation of 豭 serving as a sound element; regular script writes 豕 beneath 宀. This account does not show that 豕 developed graphically from 豭.
The proposal that oracle-bone 家 had 𢑓 as its lower sign, later altered or misread as 豕, remains unverified.

uncertainties.text: The lower element’s earliest identity and role are unsettled: some analyses treat it as a pig contributing to the scene, while the traditional account treats it as an abbreviated sound element. The proposed original meaning “pig enclosure” is not established.
Matching readings for 家 and 豭 do not prove that the earliest lower sign was named 豭. No independent ancient pronunciation for the proposed depicted animal or sign is established.

senses.period: Oracle-bone uses are reported; dates of individual examples are unresolved
senses.text: Early uses associated with dwelling, including human dwelling in oracle-bone contexts, are reported. A pig-enclosure origin has been proposed but is not established as the earliest meaning.

senses.gloss: ancestral temple, family, royal house or household unit
senses.period: Oracle-bone and bronze uses are reported; sequence unresolved
senses.text: Reported uses include ancestral temple and family, royal house or court, and households counted as 家. Their sequence and relationships are unclear.
家 commonly means house or home, and also family. How these senses connect to the reported early institutional uses is unclear.

developments.text: Dwelling and household or institutional uses are both reported early, but their sequence and any development from one to the other are unresolved.
The modern senses are established, but their chronology and transition from the early reported uses remain unclear.

limitations.text: Reports of early uses do not provide a dated sequence of examined inscriptions, so the chronology of these senses remains unresolved.

The pig-enclosure proposal connects a proposed early meaning to human dwelling; the traditional phonetic analysis offers a different account. Neither establishes the full history of the word’s meanings.

overview.text: 家 means “house,” “home,” or “family.” Early dwelling and household uses are reported, but their sequence is unresolved. The lower sign may depict a pig or, in the traditional analysis, abbreviate 豭.

components.text: 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling idea in the proposed construction.
家 jiā matches proposed sound element 豭 jiā, making the sound account plausible only if 豭 is the right analysis of visible 豕.

relationships.text: In the proposed construction, 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling category.
Some analyses interpret the lower element as a pig contributing to a scene of livestock kept beneath a roof.

The traditional analysis proposes that the visible lower form represents abbreviated 豭 used for sound. Matching readings make this plausible, but do not settle the earliest sign’s identity or establish a graphic derivation.
